editorial.blurb: Farm Bar Ravenswood delivers excellent American fare with attentive service and warm hospitality in a lively Ravenswood setting.
editorial.insiderTip: Skip the wait by making reservations ahead, especially on weekends when the place gets packed—though early Friday arrivals may snag tables without one.
